description:
Job Requirements
   

  

**Why work for us?**
 Alkegen brings together two of the world’s leading specialty materials companies to create one new, innovation\-driven leader focused on battery technologies, filtration media, and specialty insulation and sealing materials. Through global reach and breakthrough inventions, we’re delivering products that enable the world to breathe easier, live greener, and go further than ever before.
   

  

 With over 60 manufacturing facilities with a global workforce of over 9,000 of the industry’s most experienced talent, including insulation and filtration experts, Alkegen is uniquely positioned to help customers impact the environment in meaningful ways.

**Job Responsibilities**
**Job Description \- Application Engineer (Estimation \& Proposals)**
* Technical Solution: Select suitable products and prepare application concepts, specifications and material recommendations to meet customer requirements in HPI/CPI, steel, aluminium, power, cement and other high\-temperature industries.
* Project \& Site Support: Provide technical support for site surveys, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting and failure analysis.
* Estimation \& Costing: Prepare accurate BOM/MTO, material take\-offs, quantity calculations and cost estimates for CF, refractory and thermal insulation projects.
* Tender Management: Review RFQs, tender documents and specifications, identify deviations/clarifications and prepare bid submissions within timelines
* Customer Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, conducting presentations and product demonstrations to showcase the benefits and applications of Alkegen’s materials.
* Market Analysis: Stay informed about industry trends, competitive products, and customer requirements to identify opportunities for product improvement and new applications.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with sales, procurement, manufacturing and engineering teams to obtain technical and commercial inputs for proposals.
* Customer/EPC Coordination: Respond to technical queries, prepare clarifications and participate in pre\-bid and technical discussions with customers/EPCs.
* Cost Optimization: Identify alternative materials, design improvements and value\-engineering opportunities to improve project competitiveness.
* Proposal Documentation: Maintain estimation databases, costing templates, technical documents and records of submitted proposals and awarded projects.
* Product Development: Collaborate with R\&D and engineering teams to assist in the development and optimization of new products based on customer feedback and market needs.
* Team Development: Mentor junior engineers, share technical knowledge and develop standard engineering tools and practices.
* Documentation: Create and maintain technical documentation, including application notes, specifications, and case studies to support customer engagement and product development.


**Qualifications/Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Ceramic Engineering, Mechanical engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred.
* 8–12 years of relevant experience, preferably with at least 5 years in Ceramic Fibre, Refractory, thermal insulation or high\-temperature applications.
* Experience in interpreting equipment drawings, specifications, RFQs and customer/EPC tender documents.
* Good understanding of Ceramic Fibre, refractory and thermal insulation products and their applications.
* Experience in preparing technical offers, compliance statements, deviations and technical clarifications.
* Good understanding of heat transfer, thermal conductivity, heat\-loss calculations and insulation system design.
* Familiarity with API, ASTM, EIL and major EPC/customer specifications is desirable.
* Experience in HPI/CPI, steel, aluminium, power, cement or other process industries is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of materials properties and engineering principles related to product applications.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a customer\-focused mindset.
* Proficient in technical documentation and software tools relevant to engineering and project management.

description:

**Who we are?**
 Johnson Controls is the global leader for smart, healthy and sustainable buildings. At Johnson Controls, we’ve been making buildings smarter since 1885, and our capabilities, depth of innovation experience, and global reach have been growing ever since.
   

  

 Today, we offer the world’s largest portfolio of building products, technologies, software, and services; we put that portfolio to work to transform the environments where people live, work, learn and play. This is where Johnson Controls comes in, helping drive the outcomes that matter most. Through a full range of systems and digital solutions, we make your buildings smarter. Sustainability is a top priority for our company.
   

  

 We committed to invest 75 percent of new product development R\&D in climate\-related innovation to develop sustainable products and services. We take sustainability seriously. Achieving net zero carbon emissions before 2040 is just one of our commitments to making the world a better place.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Johnson Controls Digital Solutions is looking for an experienced engineer with a deep knowledge on building technologies including BMS, VMS, and Access Control etc.
   

  

 As a member of the Global Center of excellence the Presales technical lead will help customers to make technology decisions, implement best practices for asset management and overall facilitate transforming buildings into smart connected entities.
   

  

 This role requires a blend of technical expertise, customer service, and sales skills to effectively support potential clients and the sales team in understanding, evaluating, and adopting the company's digital products and solutions. You are obsessed with driving continuous process improvements to optimize solution and deliverables in presales process.

* Develop and implement pre\-sales strategies that align with the organization’s business goals \& targets.
* Review opportunity inputs, requirements and specifications; should be able to capture the Digital Solution scope and understand the complete requirements of the customer.
* Drive RFP/RFI responses, preparing technical solution writeups, compliance matrices, BoQs, Hardware sizing calculations, and architecture diagrams tailored to customer use cases across global markets.

* Design and present tailored solutions that demonstrate the value and benefits of the digital products and services.
* Conduct requirement workshops, technical discovery sessions, and PoCs, ensuring alignment of customer expectations with solution capabilities, integration pathways, data models, KPIs, and future‑state architecture.

* Develop solutions specific dashboards, reporting frameworks, and data modeling strategies as part of presales demonstrations, highlighting portfolio‑level insights and operational benefits.
* Provide technical leadership to coordinate, prioritize and deliver proposal, commercials in pre\-sales process.
* Articulate goals, desired outcomes, risks/issues and mitigation plan clearly in pre\-sales process.
* Clearly qualify out of the box solutions and possible customizations needed.
* Provide feedback to product management and development teams regarding customer needs and market demands

* 8\-10\+ years’ experience as Presales engineer and delivering proposals, commercials in overall Bid process.
* Expertise in Solutioning, designing and delivering building technology Solutions e.g. BMS, Security, Fire and Lighting.
* Hands\-on experience in SCADA Platforms (WinCC, Iconics, Ignition or similar) and PLC programming is preferred.
* Experience in IoT Gateway configuration and Device Onboarding to cloud is a must have.
* Knowledge of different types of OT/IT network protocols like BACnet, Modbus, OPC, MQTT, SNMP, AMQP and other protocols.
* knowledge of HVAC or Industrial Process Control systems, IT\-OT Integrations, API integrations.
* Knowledge of L2 and L3 Networking, Switching, Servers, Virtualization concepts and Clustering.
* knowledge of cloud IoT platforms and services (MS Azure is preferred)
* Familiar with Energy Management, Cloud based Analytics tools, Digital Twin, Digital asset management and BRICK schema concepts.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities in an energizing and fast\-paced environment.
* Experience working with industry leaders to understand current technology trends and relevancy.
* Stay updated on industry trends, competitive landscape, and new product features.


**Skills And Competencies**
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new products and technologies.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in using Integrated software and digital communication tools.
* Ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and customer\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

 The Senior Associate, Federal Grants will work directly with Ryan team members and Ryan clients/companies to support the development of government funding applications and proposals by playing a key role in researching requirements and writing and editing application and proposal content as a member of a grant writing team. They may also support Ryan in post\-award compliance activities and provide other grant\-related support requested by clients. In addition, the Senior Associate will lead research on U.S. government grants, loans, and contracts and related legislation to ensure the firm's grants knowledge is continually updated. The position will demand high attention to detail and the ability to multi\-task in constantly changing environments. The position requires strong writing, critical thinking, decision\-making, and analysis skills as well as an ability to comprehend and synthesize complex concepts and communicate clearly with stakeholders. The position requires the ability to effectively use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to enhance workflow efficiency while exercising independent judgment and critical thinking when evaluating information and making decisions.
   

  

 The position involves significant project management skills to research and support the development and writing of grant and loan applications and contract proposals that are anticipated to range from $100,000 to $100,000,000\+ in size. These funding applications are positioned to assist our clients’ businesses with their unique projects and could cover a wide array of industries included, but not limited to: energy, agriculture, health, manufacturing, industry, education, and research and development.
   

  

**Duties and responsibilities, as they align to Ryan’s Key Results**
**People**
* Overall Team Support: Our team works together to support multiple clients and priorities simultaneously. The Senior Associate will be communicating, collaborating, and working directly with Ryan Managers and Consultants and third party stakeholders.
* Project Management: This role involves leading and writing multiple, concurrent projects and managing them effectively to ensure the final products meet internal and client standards.
* Administrative Duties: Recordkeeping and reporting to senior management, including use of Ryan’s internal file and client management systems.
* Internal Meetings: Meeting preparation and facilitation for internal weekly Grant team meetings. (The primary Grants team members are currently located in Washington, DC on Eastern Time so the Senior Associate shall assume that the weekly meetings, and any client support meetings, will occur in line with Eastern Time zone.)
* Other: The Senior Associate will be called on to support special projects, high\-priority items, new/existing funding program research, review of existing materials, and updates and enhancements to team products and marketing materials, etc.


**Client**
* Funding Strategizing and Project Scoping: The Senior Associate will be responsible for researching specific funding opportunities for Ryan clients and as such will need to develop a strong understanding of our clients’ projects and areas of investment. The Senior Associate will gather/synthesize project information, identify possible grants and funding opportunities of potential relevance, and prepare reports and materials to summarize the scoped opportunities for review by Ryan staff and ultimate presentation and sharing with clients.
* Information Gathering and Analysis: Support client engagements, company and project information gathering, project scoping and strategizing, and communicating program and project details to Ryan staff and clients, if/as requested.
* Client Relationship Management: The Senior Associate may be invited to client meetings and as such will be required to manage client requests and expectations effectively. They will develop strong working relationships with Ryan staff and clients to ensure project completion and successful submission of requested deliverables.


**Value**
* Conduct Ongoing Grants Research (30%): Support with ongoing grant program research to ensure the Firm’s knowledge is up to date. This involves researching through a variety of online sources, including current U.S. Federal appropriation and legislative materials, reviewing client data and publicly available reports and information on grant and funding vehicles.
* Support Application and Proposal Research, Preparation, Writing, and Reviewing (30%): Either on their own or with a Ryan team member, work on the preparation and submission of funding applications and proposals for clients. This includes synthesizing project information gathered from research, client meetings, notes from the sales team or Manager, and previous funding proposals. They will evaluate and interpret quantitative and qualitative information from credible sources; identify supporting evidence and trends, and incorporate properly cited data into applications. The Senior Consultant will be asked to develop narrative content, budget materials, and graphically rich appendices and executive summary materials. An Engagement Manager, Director, or Senior Consultant will review work and provide feedback for changes or improvement before submitting.
* Support Systemization and Document Management (20%): As documentation for a project comes in, the Senior Associate will be responsible for filing and storing the documents appropriately on our system and ensuring they can be located for later use. The Senior Associate is responsible for maintaining the integrity and consistency of our file management system. The Senior Associate may be asked to analyze qualitative and quantitative data to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and provide data\-driven recommendations.
* Provide Sales and Marketing Support (20%): The Senior Associate will support, and sometimes lead, the development of marketing materials and sales tools and other thought leadership documentation to assist in the marketing and sales process for the U.S. federal grants sub\-practice.

 A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business/Administration, English or Communications/Journalism, or a related discipline is required. Prior experience in Grants, familiarity with U.S. government programs, and broad business experience and business plan writing would be strong assets.

* Excellent writing skills and experience presenting written submissions C level executives
